The Bitch is part of the family of Seven Card Stud variants that add special 'kill card' mechanics, alongside games like Chicago, Follow the Queen, and Black Mariah. These variants emerged from American home poker games where players sought to add drama and unpredictability to standard stud.
Standard Seven Card Stud deal: 2 cards face-down (hole cards), then cards dealt face-up one at a time with betting rounds between each. 7 cards total per player (2 down, 4 up, 1 down).
